page: Microsoft Azure E64ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eadv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per vCPU. Local storage is bundled with a capacity of 3780 GB of local disk space, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory capabilities. The server achieves top-tier status in Geekbench multi-core performance and image processing, alongside strong results in stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests. Memory bandwidth tests show a strong read-only small block cached speed of 4863.62 GB/sec and a strong write speed of 108.83 GB/sec for large blocks, though read-only large block uncached bandwidth falls into the average category at 154.13 GB/sec. Database operations are highly efficient, with Passmark database operations scoring in the top 25% and Redis SET operations reaching 89.03 million operations per second.

For language model workloads, the E64ads_v6 delivers top-tier prompt processing speeds of 4658.62 tokens per second on small 135M models, while text generation for medium 7B models remains strong at 31.09 tokens per second. However, prompt processing for larger 70B models drops to an average tier of 16.6 tokens per second. Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio, dedicated AMD EPYC processing power, and substantial local storage, this instance is suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale data processing, software compilation, and medium-scale language model inference.
